items.item_text: 01. Which option below best describes your highest level of education? (NOTE: For positions requiring college units/degree, a copy of the transcript must be included as an attachment. The transcript must be legible from an accredited institution and include your name, the institution name and confer date). Options: Some High School | High School or G.E.D. | Some College | Associates Degree | Bachelors Degree | Masters Degree | Doctorate Degree | None
02. Did you attach the required transcripts? Options: Yes | No
03. Select the career website you used to find this employment opportunity: Options: Sbccd.edu | Indeed.com | HigherEdJobs.com | EdJoin.org | CCCregistry.org | Other
04. Describe your experience coordinating, administrating, or supporting programs, services, operations, or activities related to the area of assignment. Please include length of time.
05. Do you possess an MLIS degree (Master of Library and Information Science) Options: Yes | No
06. Describe your supervisory and/or leadership experience in a library setting. Please include length of time.

07. I hereby understand and declare that the statements on this supplemental questionnaire are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. As applicable, I hereby authorize the District and/or designees to contact the references listed to verify the information I have supplied. I hereby release from liability all persons and organizations furnishing such information. I understand that the District reserves the right to validate information received on the supplemental questionnaire and that I will be subject to disqualification and/or termination if any statement in this supplemental questionnaire is found to be untrue or determined to be misleading. Options: Yes | No
